character_archetypes.name: Reluctant Protagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: avoids responsibility until circumstances make avoidance impossible.

character_archetypes.name: Active Protagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: pursues a clear goal and makes consequential choices.

character_archetypes.name: Passive Drifter
character_archetypes.core_pattern: lets events and other people determine their path; may need to choose deliberately.

character_archetypes.name: Underdog
character_archetypes.core_pattern: starts with fewer resources, status, skill, or support than the opposition.

character_archetypes.name: Outsider
character_archetypes.core_pattern: does not fit the social group, institution, family, or world they enter.

character_archetypes.name: Everyperson
character_archetypes.core_pattern: recognisable ordinary person facing an unusually demanding situation.

character_archetypes.name: Flawed Achiever
character_archetypes.core_pattern: capable and successful in one area but undermined by a personal flaw.

character_archetypes.name: Dreamer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: imagines a better life but struggles to turn desire into action.

character_archetypes.name: Idealist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: acts according to principles, sometimes underestimating practical costs.

character_archetypes.name: Cynic
character_archetypes.core_pattern: expects selfishness or failure and uses scepticism as protection.

character_archetypes.name: Antihero
character_archetypes.core_pattern: central figure whose methods or values conflict with conventional heroism.

character_archetypes.name: Morally Compromised Lead
character_archetypes.core_pattern: pursues a worthwhile goal through ethically troubling choices.

character_archetypes.name: Reluctant Leader
character_archetypes.core_pattern: earns or accepts responsibility despite doubt.

character_archetypes.name: Natural Leader
character_archetypes.core_pattern: coordinates people through confidence, competence, empathy, or authority.

character_archetypes.name: Misunderstood Protagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: others interpret their actions incorrectly; story must distinguish genuine misunderstanding from self-deception.

character_archetypes.name: Self-Saboteur
character_archetypes.core_pattern: repeatedly damages their own goals through fear, pride, avoidance, or habit.

character_archetypes.name: Perfectionist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: seeks control and excellence at a personal or relational cost.

character_archetypes.name: People-Pleaser
character_archetypes.core_pattern: sacrifices honest needs to avoid disapproval.

character_archetypes.name: Approval-Seeker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: measures self-worth through recognition and status.

character_archetypes.name: Escapist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: avoids difficult reality through fantasy, work, substances, humour, romance, or distraction.

character_archetypes.name: Survivor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: prioritises staying alive or stable after danger, loss, or abuse.

character_archetypes.name: Reinventor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: attempts to become a different person, sometimes without addressing the past.

character_archetypes.name: Late Bloomer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: discovers ability, purpose, or courage later than expected.

character_archetypes.name: Reluctant Competitor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: dislikes rivalry but is forced to define what winning means.

character_archetypes.name: Obsessive Pursuer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: narrows life around one objective and risks losing perspective.

character_archetypes.name: Ordinary Person in Extraordinary Circumstances
character_archetypes.core_pattern: reveals character through adaptation rather than special powers.

character_archetypes.name: Chosen-One Figure
character_archetypes.core_pattern: receives unusual responsibility or destiny; needs individual desires beyond the prophecy.

character_archetypes.name: Gifted but Immature Lead
character_archetypes.core_pattern: has ability without discipline, emotional insight, or responsibility.

character_archetypes.name: Competent but Unrecognised Lead
character_archetypes.core_pattern: does valuable work that others overlook.

character_archetypes.name: Fallen Hero
character_archetypes.core_pattern: loses status, trust, or moral authority and must face consequences.

character_archetypes.name: Returning Protagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: comes home or returns to an old environment changed by experience.

character_archetypes.name: Double-Life Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: maintains conflicting identities, roles, or secrets.

character_archetypes.name: Reluctant Truth-Seeker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: wants answers but fears what the truth will cost.

character_archetypes.name: Idealistic Reformer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: tries to change a family, workplace, institution, or society.

character_archetypes.name: Survivor with Agency
character_archetypes.core_pattern: moves from enduring events to actively shaping their future.

character_archetypes.name: Tragic Protagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: possesses a quality or flaw that contributes to their downfall.

character_archetypes.name: Comic Protagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: generates humour through perspective, behaviour, decisions, or social friction.

character_archetypes.name: Ensemble Protagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: shares narrative focus with other central characters.

character_archetypes.name: Unreliable Protagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: presents a partial, distorted, or deceptive account of events.

character_archetypes.name: Anti-destiny Protagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: resists the role others have assigned to them.

character_archetypes.name: Power-Seeking Antagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: wants control, influence, territory, or status.

character_archetypes.name: Ideological Opponent
character_archetypes.core_pattern: genuinely believes a different system of values is correct.

character_archetypes.name: Mirror Antagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: resembles the protagonist but makes different choices.

character_archetypes.name: Charismatic Villain
character_archetypes.core_pattern: attracts loyalty through charm, vision, confidence, or performance.

character_archetypes.name: Quiet Strategist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: controls events through planning, patience, and information.

character_archetypes.name: Impulsive Threat
character_archetypes.core_pattern: acts quickly and unpredictably, creating instability.

character_archetypes.name: Controlling Authority Figure
character_archetypes.core_pattern: maintains order through coercion, fear, or rigid rules.

character_archetypes.name: Corrupt Official
character_archetypes.core_pattern: exploits a position meant to serve the public.

character_archetypes.name: Corporate or Institutional Antagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: represents incentives and systems that harm individuals.

character_archetypes.name: Intimate Antagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: uses closeness, trust, or shared history to exert control.

character_archetypes.name: Rival
character_archetypes.core_pattern: competes for the same goal, recognition, role, love, or resource.

character_archetypes.name: Respectful Rival
character_archetypes.core_pattern: creates pressure while recognising the protagonist's ability.

character_archetypes.name: Petty Rival
character_archetypes.core_pattern: escalates minor comparisons into disproportionate conflict.

character_archetypes.name: Jealous Rival
character_archetypes.core_pattern: interprets another person's success as a threat to self-worth.

character_archetypes.name: Bully
character_archetypes.core_pattern: establishes dominance by humiliating or intimidating others.

character_archetypes.name: Opportunist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: changes loyalties according to advantage.

character_archetypes.name: Fanatic
character_archetypes.core_pattern: subordinates people and evidence to an absolute belief.

character_archetypes.name: Zealot with a Just Cause
character_archetypes.core_pattern: pursues a defensible goal through harmful certainty or methods.

character_archetypes.name: Revenge-Seeker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: organises life around repayment for a perceived wrong.

character_archetypes.name: Punisher
character_archetypes.core_pattern: believes suffering is deserved and appoints themselves judge.

character_archetypes.name: Predator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: identifies vulnerability and exploits it.

character_archetypes.name: Manipulator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: steers choices through guilt, flattery, fear, confusion, or selective truth.

character_archetypes.name: Gaslighter
character_archetypes.core_pattern: persistently tries to destabilise another person's trust in their perception of reality.

character_archetypes.name: Blackmailer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: uses damaging information as leverage.

character_archetypes.name: Deceiver
character_archetypes.core_pattern: maintains a false story to protect a goal or identity.

character_archetypes.name: False Ally
character_archetypes.core_pattern: offers help while serving another agenda.

character_archetypes.name: Sympathetic Antagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: has understandable needs but causes real harm.

character_archetypes.name: Reluctant Antagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: opposes the lead because of duty, pressure, or limited options.

character_archetypes.name: Tragic Antagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: becomes destructive through loss, fear, pride, or rigid belief.

character_archetypes.name: Enforcer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: carries out another person's will through force or intimidation.

character_archetypes.name: Gatekeeper
character_archetypes.core_pattern: controls access to a person, opportunity, institution, or truth.

character_archetypes.name: Bureaucratic Obstacle
character_archetypes.core_pattern: follows procedures that frustrate urgent human needs.

character_archetypes.name: Social Antagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: embodies group pressure, prejudice, gossip, or exclusion.

character_archetypes.name: Nature or Environment as Opposition
character_archetypes.core_pattern: weather, terrain, illness, isolation, or scarcity creates conflict.

character_archetypes.name: Internal Antagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: the protagonist's addiction, shame, fear, compulsion, or belief acts as opposition.

character_archetypes.name: Anonymous Threat
character_archetypes.core_pattern: danger whose identity or motive is initially unknown.

character_archetypes.name: Benevolent Controller
character_archetypes.core_pattern: claims to protect others while denying their autonomy.

character_archetypes.name: Failed Reformer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: once sought improvement but becomes what they opposed.

character_archetypes.name: Rival-Friend
character_archetypes.core_pattern: affection and competition coexist.

character_archetypes.name: Antagonist Who Wins Temporarily
character_archetypes.core_pattern: creates credible setbacks and forces adaptation.

character_archetypes.name: Deadpan Observer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: reacts to absurdity with minimal visible emotion.

character_archetypes.name: Literal Thinker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: interprets figurative or indirect speech literally.

character_archetypes.name: Clueless Questioner
character_archetypes.core_pattern: asks questions that reveal a gap in awareness or expose an absurd premise.

character_archetypes.name: Overconfident Fool
character_archetypes.core_pattern: acts certain despite limited knowledge or ability.

character_archetypes.name: Nervous Talker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: fills silence with rambling when anxious.

character_archetypes.name: Nervous Deflector
character_archetypes.core_pattern: uses jokes to avoid fear, grief, embarrassment, or intimacy.

character_archetypes.name: Compulsive Exaggerator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: turns small events into dramatic stories.

character_archetypes.name: Habitual Liar
character_archetypes.core_pattern: invents explanations and gets trapped by them.

character_archetypes.name: Bad Improviser
character_archetypes.core_pattern: tries to bluff through situations and makes them worse.

character_archetypes.name: Socially Awkward Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: misreads timing, cues, boundaries, or expectations.

character_archetypes.name: Status Pretender
character_archetypes.core_pattern: performs wealth, sophistication, expertise, or influence they do not possess.

character_archetypes.name: Status-Anxious Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: constantly monitors rank and comparison.

character_archetypes.name: Pedant
character_archetypes.core_pattern: insists on technical correctness at socially inconvenient moments.

character_archetypes.name: Know-It-All
character_archetypes.core_pattern: needs to display knowledge even when it is irrelevant or wrong.

character_archetypes.name: Fake Expert
character_archetypes.core_pattern: uses jargon and confidence to conceal incompetence.

character_archetypes.name: Practical Realist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: punctures grand claims with mundane facts.

character_archetypes.name: Sarcastic Critic
character_archetypes.core_pattern: uses irony to expose vanity, hypocrisy, or frustration.

character_archetypes.name: Teasing Friend
character_archetypes.core_pattern: expresses closeness through playful provocation; must respect character-specific boundaries.

character_archetypes.name: Roaster
character_archetypes.core_pattern: targets flaws or pretensions through pointed humour; risk of cruelty must be considered.

character_archetypes.name: Self-Deprecator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: makes themselves the target to manage insecurity or build connection.

character_archetypes.name: Mischief-Maker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: creates disorder for fun, revenge, attention, or curiosity.

character_archetypes.name: Accidental Troublemaker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: causes chaos without intending harm.

character_archetypes.name: Chaos Agent
character_archetypes.core_pattern: disrupts routines and forces other characters to improvise.

character_archetypes.name: Overreactor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: responds to minor events with disproportionate intensity.

character_archetypes.name: Underreactor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: responds to major events with strikingly little emotion.

character_archetypes.name: Dramatic Performer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: turns everyday events into theatrical performances.

character_archetypes.name: Petty Grudge-Keeper
character_archetypes.core_pattern: remembers small slights and seeks absurdly elaborate payback.

character_archetypes.name: Rule-Bender
character_archetypes.core_pattern: finds loopholes and takes pride in getting around rules.

character_archetypes.name: Rule-Obsessed Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: follows rules even when the context makes them ridiculous.

character_archetypes.name: Misguided Helper
character_archetypes.core_pattern: sincerely helps but misunderstands what help is needed.

character_archetypes.name: Unwanted Adviser
character_archetypes.core_pattern: gives unsolicited guidance and often exposes their own flaws.

character_archetypes.name: Competitive One-Upper
character_archetypes.core_pattern: must top every story or achievement.

character_archetypes.name: Story Hijacker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: redirects every conversation toward their own experience.

character_archetypes.name: Chronic Interruptor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: interrupts through enthusiasm, anxiety, dominance, or poor listening.

character_archetypes.name: Awkward Flirt
character_archetypes.core_pattern: attempts charm but reveals insecurity or poor social timing.

character_archetypes.name: Romantic Misinterpreter
character_archetypes.core_pattern: reads ordinary friendliness as romantic interest or misses clear signals.

character_archetypes.name: Jealous Comic
character_archetypes.core_pattern: tries to hide jealousy and becomes increasingly obvious.

character_archetypes.name: Petty Schemer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: designs complicated plans for trivial rewards.

character_archetypes.name: Bluffing Coward
character_archetypes.core_pattern: acts brave until danger becomes real.

character_archetypes.name: Coward with One Brave Moment
character_archetypes.core_pattern: fear is genuine, but loyalty eventually overrides it.

character_archetypes.name: Competent Person Surrounded by Fools
character_archetypes.core_pattern: humour arises from maintaining standards amid chaos.

character_archetypes.name: Fool Who Accidentally Sees the Truth
character_archetypes.core_pattern: ignorance or outsider status lets them notice an obvious contradiction.

character_archetypes.name: Straight Man
character_archetypes.core_pattern: provides a grounded reaction that makes another character's behaviour funny.

character_archetypes.name: Comic Foil
character_archetypes.core_pattern: highlights another character's quirks through contrast.

character_archetypes.name: Comic Duo: Dominant/Reactive
character_archetypes.core_pattern: one drives the bit while the other resists, enables, or reacts.

character_archetypes.name: Comic Duo: Planner/Disaster
character_archetypes.core_pattern: one creates plans and the other ruins them.

character_archetypes.name: Comic Duo: Literal/Abstract
character_archetypes.core_pattern: one wants concrete facts while the other speaks in grand ideas.

character_archetypes.name: Comic Duo: Optimist/Cynic
character_archetypes.core_pattern: opposite expectations produce friction.

character_archetypes.name: Comic Duo: Braggart/Verifier
character_archetypes.core_pattern: boasts meet someone who knows the facts.

character_archetypes.name: Humourless Character in Absurd Circumstances
character_archetypes.core_pattern: treats ridiculous events as serious business.

character_archetypes.name: Socially Powerful Fool
character_archetypes.core_pattern: gets away with incompetence because of status or connections.

character_archetypes.name: Childlike Adult
character_archetypes.core_pattern: approaches the world with curiosity but may lack responsibility.

character_archetypes.name: Immature Adult
character_archetypes.core_pattern: avoids accountability despite age or status.

character_archetypes.name: Involuntary Confessor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: reveals secrets while trying to conceal them.

character_archetypes.name: Miscommunication Engine
character_archetypes.core_pattern: creates escalating trouble through incomplete or mistaken information.

character_archetypes.name: Physical Comic
character_archetypes.core_pattern: humour depends on movement, timing, spatial mishaps, or bodily reactions.

character_archetypes.name: Reaction Comic
character_archetypes.core_pattern: facial expressions and silent responses carry the joke.

character_archetypes.name: Verbal Duelist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: humour comes from competitive language and fast repartee.

character_archetypes.name: Absurdist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: behaves according to an unexpected but internally consistent logic.

character_archetypes.name: Dark-Humour Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: uses humour around uncomfortable or grim realities; tone requires care.

character_archetypes.name: Gallows-Humour Survivor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: jokes in danger as a coping strategy.

character_archetypes.name: Bureaucratic Comic
character_archetypes.core_pattern: treats pointless procedures as sacred.

character_archetypes.name: Earnest Enthusiast
character_archetypes.core_pattern: enthusiasm is disproportionate but sincere.

character_archetypes.name: Failed Seducer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: mistakes persistence or performance for genuine connection.

character_archetypes.name: Petty Authority
character_archetypes.core_pattern: enjoys enforcing tiny amounts of power.

character_archetypes.name: Unreliable Boaster
character_archetypes.core_pattern: stories grow as evidence weakens.

character_archetypes.name: Opportunistic Friend
character_archetypes.core_pattern: helps when convenient and disappears when costly.

character_archetypes.name: Innocent Instigator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: asks an honest question that exposes a taboo or contradiction.

character_archetypes.name: Emotional Avoider
character_archetypes.core_pattern: turns every sincere moment into banter.

character_archetypes.name: Situational Comic
character_archetypes.core_pattern: becomes funny because of a mismatch between person, place, timing, and stakes.

Comedy safety for scene fit: a comic role can release tension, sharpen tension, reveal character, expose hypocrisy, or undermine emotion. Do not assume comic relief is always beneficial. Check whether the joke targets power, behaviour, circumstance, or a vulnerable person.

character_archetypes.name: Guarded Lover
character_archetypes.core_pattern: wants closeness but protects themselves from rejection.

character_archetypes.name: Openly Affectionate Lover
character_archetypes.core_pattern: expresses care directly and consistently.

character_archetypes.name: Emotionally Avoidant Lover
character_archetypes.core_pattern: withdraws when intimacy demands vulnerability.

character_archetypes.name: Anxious Lover
character_archetypes.core_pattern: seeks reassurance and may misread distance as rejection.

character_archetypes.name: Secure Partner
character_archetypes.core_pattern: communicates needs and respects boundaries.

character_archetypes.name: Idealising Lover
character_archetypes.core_pattern: falls in love with an imagined version of the other person.

character_archetypes.name: Disillusioned Romantic
character_archetypes.core_pattern: wants love but distrusts romantic narratives.

character_archetypes.name: Practical Partner
character_archetypes.core_pattern: expresses love through reliability and concrete help.

character_archetypes.name: Grand Gesture Romantic
character_archetypes.core_pattern: believes dramatic action proves devotion; may overlook everyday needs.

character_archetypes.name: Quietly Devoted Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: demonstrates affection through small repeated actions.

character_archetypes.name: Flirt
character_archetypes.core_pattern: tests mutual attraction through play, attention, and ambiguity.

character_archetypes.name: Awkward Suitor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: struggles to express interest without self-consciousness.

character_archetypes.name: Unavailable Lover
character_archetypes.core_pattern: cannot or will not offer the relationship the other person wants.

character_archetypes.name: Ambivalent Lover
character_archetypes.core_pattern: feels attraction and resistance simultaneously.

character_archetypes.name: Fearful Commitment-Avoider
character_archetypes.core_pattern: treats commitment as a threat to freedom or identity.

character_archetypes.name: Overcommitted Rescuer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: confuses being needed with being loved.

character_archetypes.name: Jealous Partner
character_archetypes.core_pattern: interprets uncertainty as threat and may become controlling.

character_archetypes.name: Possessive Partner
character_archetypes.core_pattern: treats the other person as an entitlement rather than an autonomous person.

character_archetypes.name: Boundary-Setter
character_archetypes.core_pattern: clearly communicates limits and consequences.

character_archetypes.name: People-Pleasing Partner
character_archetypes.core_pattern: suppresses disagreement to preserve the relationship.

character_archetypes.name: Conflict-Avoidant Couple Member
character_archetypes.core_pattern: delays difficult conversations until resentment grows.

character_archetypes.name: Honest but Unkind Partner
character_archetypes.core_pattern: values truth but ignores the impact of delivery.

character_archetypes.name: Kind but Dishonest Partner
character_archetypes.core_pattern: avoids immediate pain through concealment.

character_archetypes.name: Mismatched Communicator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: one speaks directly while the other relies on hints or silence.

character_archetypes.name: Friends-to-Lovers Catalyst
character_archetypes.core_pattern: changes an established friendship through new awareness.

character_archetypes.name: Rivals-to-Lovers Partner
character_archetypes.core_pattern: attraction develops through competition and recognition.

character_archetypes.name: Second-Chance Lover
character_archetypes.core_pattern: revisits a relationship with unresolved history.

character_archetypes.name: Forbidden-Love Partner
character_archetypes.core_pattern: faces external or internal barriers to intimacy.

character_archetypes.name: Unrequited Lover
character_archetypes.core_pattern: loves someone who does not reciprocate.

character_archetypes.name: Rebound Partner
character_archetypes.core_pattern: enters a relationship while still processing another one.

character_archetypes.name: Emotional Affair Participant
character_archetypes.core_pattern: forms an intimate bond that violates existing agreements.

character_archetypes.name: Honest Breaker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: ends a relationship clearly despite pain.

character_archetypes.name: Avoidant Breaker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: disappears, delays, or creates conflict instead of ending things honestly.

character_archetypes.name: Recovering Heartbreak Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: rebuilds identity after loss.

character_archetypes.name: Love-Interest with Independent Agency
character_archetypes.core_pattern: has goals, contradictions, and a life beyond the protagonist.

character_archetypes.name: Romantic Foil
character_archetypes.core_pattern: reveals the protagonist's needs by offering a contrasting relationship style.

character_archetypes.name: False Match
character_archetypes.core_pattern: looks ideal on paper but exposes incompatibility in practice.

character_archetypes.name: Unexpected Match
character_archetypes.core_pattern: forms connection through shared values rather than initial attraction.

character_archetypes.name: Caretaking Lover
character_archetypes.core_pattern: provides support but risks taking over the partner's life.

character_archetypes.name: Transformative Partner
character_archetypes.core_pattern: encourages change without becoming responsible for the other's entire growth.

character_archetypes.name: Protective Parent
character_archetypes.core_pattern: prioritises safety, sometimes at the cost of independence.

character_archetypes.name: Controlling Parent
character_archetypes.core_pattern: uses authority, fear, guilt, or resources to direct a child's life.

character_archetypes.name: Emotionally Absent Parent
character_archetypes.core_pattern: provides little emotional attention despite physical presence.

character_archetypes.name: Affectionate but Inarticulate Parent
character_archetypes.core_pattern: cares deeply but struggles to verbalise it.

character_archetypes.name: Sacrificing Parent
character_archetypes.core_pattern: gives up personal needs for family; may create guilt or hidden resentment.

character_archetypes.name: Ambitious Parent
character_archetypes.core_pattern: treats achievement as security, identity, or family honour.

character_archetypes.name: Disappointed Parent
character_archetypes.core_pattern: cannot reconcile a child's reality with their expectations.

character_archetypes.name: Parent Seeking Redemption
character_archetypes.core_pattern: acknowledges past harm and attempts repair.

character_archetypes.name: Childified Parent
character_archetypes.core_pattern: relies on the child for emotional care or adult responsibilities.

character_archetypes.name: Golden Child
character_archetypes.core_pattern: receives disproportionate praise or freedom.

character_archetypes.name: Scapegoated Child
character_archetypes.core_pattern: absorbs family blame and tension.

character_archetypes.name: Responsible Eldest Sibling
character_archetypes.core_pattern: carries duties beyond their age or role.

character_archetypes.name: Rebellious Sibling
character_archetypes.core_pattern: challenges family rules and exposes hidden contradictions.

character_archetypes.name: Rival Siblings
character_archetypes.core_pattern: compete for approval, inheritance, identity, or attention.

character_archetypes.name: Protective Sibling
character_archetypes.core_pattern: supports another while struggling to allow independence.

character_archetypes.name: Estranged Sibling
character_archetypes.core_pattern: carries unresolved history and distance.

character_archetypes.name: Peacekeeper
character_archetypes.core_pattern: suppresses conflict to keep the family functioning.

character_archetypes.name: Truth-Teller
character_archetypes.core_pattern: names what everyone else avoids.

character_archetypes.name: Family Mediator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: translates between incompatible personalities.

character_archetypes.name: Family Secret-Keeper
character_archetypes.core_pattern: protects a person or system through concealment.

character_archetypes.name: Family Black Sheep
character_archetypes.core_pattern: refuses or fails to meet group expectations.

character_archetypes.name: Tradition Keeper
character_archetypes.core_pattern: preserves rituals and identity, sometimes resisting necessary change.

character_archetypes.name: Tradition Challenger
character_archetypes.core_pattern: questions inherited expectations and their costs.

character_archetypes.name: Elder with Quiet Authority
character_archetypes.core_pattern: influences others through experience and trust rather than force.

character_archetypes.name: Elder Who Refuses Change
character_archetypes.core_pattern: treats age or status as proof of correctness.

character_archetypes.name: Grandparent as Emotional Anchor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: offers continuity, warmth, memory, or an alternate viewpoint.

character_archetypes.name: In-Law as Gatekeeper
character_archetypes.core_pattern: controls acceptance, access, or family legitimacy.

character_archetypes.name: In-Law as Unexpected Ally
character_archetypes.core_pattern: sees the protagonist more clearly than their own family does.

character_archetypes.name: Dutiful Relative
character_archetypes.core_pattern: fulfils obligations while concealing personal dissatisfaction.

character_archetypes.name: Opportunistic Relative
character_archetypes.core_pattern: treats family ties as a resource.

character_archetypes.name: Family Caregiver
character_archetypes.core_pattern: carries practical and emotional labour, often invisibly.

character_archetypes.name: Resentful Caregiver
character_archetypes.core_pattern: loves the person they care for but feels trapped by the role.

character_archetypes.name: Absent Family Member
character_archetypes.core_pattern: shapes the story through missing presence, memory, or unresolved loss.

character_archetypes.name: Chosen Family Member
character_archetypes.core_pattern: provides belonging outside biological or legal family.

character_archetypes.name: Family Myth-Maker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: repeats a selective version of family history.

character_archetypes.name: Reconciler
character_archetypes.core_pattern: attempts to repair a broken family relationship.

character_archetypes.name: Boundary-Breaking Relative
character_archetypes.core_pattern: assumes closeness grants access or control.

character_archetypes.name: Financial Provider
character_archetypes.core_pattern: expresses responsibility through money while struggling with emotional intimacy.

character_archetypes.name: Dependent Adult
character_archetypes.core_pattern: relies on family support and may resist responsibility.

character_archetypes.name: Family Exile
character_archetypes.core_pattern: is rejected or leaves the family system and must build a new identity.

character_archetypes.name: Loyal Friend
character_archetypes.core_pattern: remains present when support becomes costly.

character_archetypes.name: Fair-Weather Friend
character_archetypes.core_pattern: enjoys companionship but avoids hardship.

character_archetypes.name: Honest Friend
character_archetypes.core_pattern: tells difficult truths without abandoning care.

character_archetypes.name: Enabling Friend
character_archetypes.core_pattern: protects someone from consequences and prolongs a problem.

character_archetypes.name: Competitive Friend
character_archetypes.core_pattern: mixes affection with comparison.

character_archetypes.name: Friend Who Wants More
character_archetypes.core_pattern: experiences romantic or status desires inside a friendship.

character_archetypes.name: Group Leader
character_archetypes.core_pattern: organises the group and shapes its decisions.

character_archetypes.name: Social Glue
character_archetypes.core_pattern: keeps people connected through effort, warmth, or mediation.

character_archetypes.name: Outsider in the Friend Group
character_archetypes.core_pattern: reveals the group's unspoken rules.

character_archetypes.name: Newcomer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: changes established dynamics by entering the group.

character_archetypes.name: Old Friend as Living Memory
character_archetypes.core_pattern: reminds the protagonist of an earlier identity.

character_archetypes.name: Drifting Friend
character_archetypes.core_pattern: grows away through changing priorities rather than one dramatic betrayal.

character_archetypes.name: Betraying Friend
character_archetypes.core_pattern: violates trust through fear, ambition, resentment, or self-interest.

character_archetypes.name: Guilty Friend
character_archetypes.core_pattern: struggles after causing harm.

character_archetypes.name: Friend Who Outgrows the Protagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: exposes stagnation or divergent values.

character_archetypes.name: Friend Who Refuses to Grow
character_archetypes.core_pattern: preserves familiarity at another person's expense.

character_archetypes.name: Carefree Companion
character_archetypes.core_pattern: encourages spontaneity and escape from routine.

character_archetypes.name: Responsible Companion
character_archetypes.core_pattern: manages logistics and consequences.

character_archetypes.name: Group Scapegoat
character_archetypes.core_pattern: absorbs jokes, blame, or frustration.

character_archetypes.name: Group Status-Seeker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: constantly ranks members and competes for attention.

character_archetypes.name: Mediator Friend
character_archetypes.core_pattern: de-escalates disputes.

character_archetypes.name: Instigator Friend
character_archetypes.core_pattern: pushes the group into risky or revealing situations.

character_archetypes.name: Quiet Supporter
character_archetypes.core_pattern: helps without seeking credit.

character_archetypes.name: Opportunistic Networker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: treats friendship as access to influence.

character_archetypes.name: Community Elder
character_archetypes.core_pattern: holds memory, informal authority, or local knowledge.

character_archetypes.name: Gossip Carrier
character_archetypes.core_pattern: moves information through a community, altering its meaning.

character_archetypes.name: Rumour Victim
character_archetypes.core_pattern: suffers from a story others circulate.

character_archetypes.name: Neighbour as Witness
character_archetypes.core_pattern: observes private life from the edge of the household.

character_archetypes.name: Community Conformist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: enforces group norms to preserve belonging.

character_archetypes.name: Community Dissenter
character_archetypes.core_pattern: challenges accepted norms and faces social costs.

character_archetypes.name: Wise Mentor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: offers perspective but should not solve every problem for the protagonist.

character_archetypes.name: Practical Mentor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: teaches through tasks, discipline, and consequences.

character_archetypes.name: Reluctant Mentor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: resists teaching because of exhaustion, fear, or past failure.

character_archetypes.name: Flawed Mentor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: offers valuable knowledge while embodying unresolved problems.

character_archetypes.name: Fallen Mentor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: loses credibility and forces the student to reassess their beliefs.

character_archetypes.name: Manipulative Mentor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: uses guidance to create dependence or control.

character_archetypes.name: Tough Coach
character_archetypes.core_pattern: pushes performance through demanding standards.

character_archetypes.name: Compassionate Teacher
character_archetypes.core_pattern: recognises potential and provides encouragement.

character_archetypes.name: Unfair Teacher
character_archetypes.core_pattern: uses authority arbitrarily or humiliates students.

character_archetypes.name: Gatekeeping Expert
character_archetypes.core_pattern: controls access to specialised knowledge or opportunity.

character_archetypes.name: Apprenticing Student
character_archetypes.core_pattern: learns by imitation, failure, and observation.

character_archetypes.name: Rebellious Student
character_archetypes.core_pattern: challenges the mentor's assumptions.

character_archetypes.name: Rival Mentor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: competes with another guide for influence.

character_archetypes.name: Accidental Mentor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: teaches through ordinary behaviour rather than formal instruction.

character_archetypes.name: Peer Mentor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: helps through shared experience rather than hierarchy.

character_archetypes.name: Institutional Authority
character_archetypes.core_pattern: represents a school, workplace, court, or organisation.

character_archetypes.name: Ethical Authority
character_archetypes.core_pattern: uses power transparently and accepts accountability.

character_archetypes.name: Insecure Authority
character_archetypes.core_pattern: demands obedience because they fear losing status.

character_archetypes.name: Benevolent Bureaucrat
character_archetypes.core_pattern: tries to help within rigid procedures.

character_archetypes.name: Rule-Bound Official
character_archetypes.core_pattern: values compliance over context.

character_archetypes.name: Whistleblower
character_archetypes.core_pattern: exposes wrongdoing at personal risk.

character_archetypes.name: Reformer Inside the System
character_archetypes.core_pattern: attempts change from within.

character_archetypes.name: Disillusioned Professional
character_archetypes.core_pattern: once believed in the institution but now doubts it.

character_archetypes.name: Protector with Limits
character_archetypes.core_pattern: wants to help but cannot control the outcome.

character_archetypes.name: Authority Who Admits Error
character_archetypes.core_pattern: models accountability and changes the power dynamic.

character_archetypes.name: Ambitious Climber
character_archetypes.core_pattern: pursues promotion, prestige, or influence.

character_archetypes.name: Quiet Expert
character_archetypes.core_pattern: possesses deep skill without self-promotion.

character_archetypes.name: Impostor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: fears being exposed as less capable than others believe.

character_archetypes.name: Credit Thief
character_archetypes.core_pattern: claims another person's work.

character_archetypes.name: Exploitative Boss
character_archetypes.core_pattern: extracts labour while withholding respect or resources.

character_archetypes.name: Insecure Boss
character_archetypes.core_pattern: controls details to hide their own uncertainty.

character_archetypes.name: Supportive Manager
character_archetypes.core_pattern: creates conditions for others to succeed.

character_archetypes.name: Burned-Out Professional
character_archetypes.core_pattern: has lost energy or meaning after prolonged demands.

character_archetypes.name: Idealistic Newcomer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: expects fairness and discovers institutional reality.

character_archetypes.name: Veteran Cynic
character_archetypes.core_pattern: understands the system but may discourage change.

character_archetypes.name: Office Politician
character_archetypes.core_pattern: manages alliances and perceptions.

character_archetypes.name: Competent Undervalued Worker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: delivers results without recognition.

character_archetypes.name: Rule-Following Employee
character_archetypes.core_pattern: prioritises safety and predictability.

character_archetypes.name: Creative Disruptor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: challenges process to find better solutions.

character_archetypes.name: Shortcut-Taker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: chooses speed over quality and transfers risk to others.

character_archetypes.name: Ethical Dilemma Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: must choose between livelihood and principle.

character_archetypes.name: Career Sacrificer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: gives up relationships or health for advancement.

character_archetypes.name: Reluctant Entrepreneur
character_archetypes.core_pattern: starts a venture from necessity rather than passion.

character_archetypes.name: Failed Entrepreneur
character_archetypes.core_pattern: confronts debt, identity, and public judgement.

character_archetypes.name: Passionate Craftsperson
character_archetypes.core_pattern: values the work itself more than status.

character_archetypes.name: Inherited Successor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: receives an opportunity and must prove or redefine themselves.

character_archetypes.name: Nepotistic Beneficiary
character_archetypes.core_pattern: gains access through connections and may ignore the resulting unfairness.

character_archetypes.name: Union or Collective Organiser
character_archetypes.core_pattern: coordinates people around shared interests.

character_archetypes.name: Exploited Worker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: faces unequal power and limited options.

character_archetypes.name: Customer-Facing Mask
character_archetypes.core_pattern: performs friendliness despite private frustration.

character_archetypes.name: Service Worker as Observer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: sees many social worlds while remaining overlooked.

character_archetypes.name: Failed Artist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: negotiates ambition, compromise, and identity.

character_archetypes.name: Commercially Successful Artist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: struggles between audience demand and personal vision.

character_archetypes.name: Perfectionist Collaborator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: improves quality but can delay or exhaust a team.

character_archetypes.name: Deadline Gambler
character_archetypes.core_pattern: relies on last-minute effort and luck.

character_archetypes.name: Competent Crisis Manager
character_archetypes.core_pattern: becomes effective when others panic.

character_archetypes.name: Workplace Scapegoat
character_archetypes.core_pattern: receives blame for systemic failures.

character_archetypes.name: Quiet Saboteur
character_archetypes.core_pattern: undermines a colleague while maintaining plausible deniability.

character_archetypes.name: Mentor-Colleague
character_archetypes.core_pattern: supports another's growth without formal authority.

character_archetypes.name: Career Changer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: gives up a stable identity to pursue a different life.

character_archetypes.name: Emotionally Repressed Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: suppresses feelings to maintain control or safety.

character_archetypes.name: Emotionally Expressive Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: makes feelings visible and may struggle to regulate their expression.

character_archetypes.name: Shame-Driven Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: hides parts of themselves they believe make them unworthy.

character_archetypes.name: Guilt-Driven Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: seeks punishment, repair, or absolution after perceived wrongdoing.

character_archetypes.name: Grief-Struck Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: reorganises life around a loss.

character_archetypes.name: Numb Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: experiences reduced emotional access after stress or loss.

character_archetypes.name: Hypervigilant Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: constantly scans for danger or rejection.

character_archetypes.name: Avoidant Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: escapes discomfort through distance, distraction, or minimisation.

character_archetypes.name: Anxious Anticipator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: rehearses possible failures and struggles to act under uncertainty.

character_archetypes.name: Control-Seeker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: reduces uncertainty by managing people, routines, or details.

character_archetypes.name: Perfectionistic Self-Critic
character_archetypes.core_pattern: interprets mistakes as evidence of personal inadequacy.

character_archetypes.name: Self-Deceiver
character_archetypes.core_pattern: maintains a story that protects identity from painful evidence.

character_archetypes.name: Rationaliser
character_archetypes.core_pattern: explains questionable actions as necessary or justified.

character_archetypes.name: Projection-Prone Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: attributes their own unwanted motives or feelings to others.

character_archetypes.name: Denier
character_archetypes.core_pattern: refuses to acknowledge a reality that threatens stability.

character_archetypes.name: Compartmentaliser
character_archetypes.core_pattern: keeps incompatible parts of life psychologically separate.

character_archetypes.name: Dissociative or Detached Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: experiences disconnection; portrayal should be researched and not used as a generic twist.

character_archetypes.name: Obsessive Fixator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: cannot disengage from a thought, person, task, or perceived threat.

character_archetypes.name: Compulsive Pleaser
character_archetypes.core_pattern: seeks safety through compliance.

character_archetypes.name: Resentful Martyr
character_archetypes.core_pattern: sacrifices while keeping an unspoken ledger of debts.

character_archetypes.name: Envious Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: experiences another person's success as evidence of their own inadequacy.

character_archetypes.name: Proud Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: protects dignity even when humility would help.

character_archetypes.name: Humiliated Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: reorganises behaviour around a perceived public loss.

character_archetypes.name: Identity-Seeking Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: tries on roles while discovering personal values.

character_archetypes.name: Self-Forgiving Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: learns to accept responsibility without defining the entire self by a mistake.

character_archetypes.name: Self-Punishing Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: believes suffering is required to balance wrongdoing.

character_archetypes.name: Emotionally Literate Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: can name feelings and distinguish them from actions.

character_archetypes.name: Emotionally Illiterate Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: feels strongly but cannot identify or communicate the feeling.

character_archetypes.name: Boundary-Learning Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: learns to distinguish care from control and responsibility from self-erasure.

character_archetypes.name: Relapse-Prone Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: makes progress, returns to an old pattern, and must confront its triggers.

character_archetypes.name: Grief-Avoiding Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: stays busy or angry to avoid mourning.

character_archetypes.name: Survivor's Guilt Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: struggles with having survived when others did not.

character_archetypes.name: Hopeful Realist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: acknowledges hardship while retaining practical possibility.

character_archetypes.name: Learned Helplessness Pattern
character_archetypes.core_pattern: expects effort to fail; portray with nuance, not as laziness.

character_archetypes.name: Emotional Contagion Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: strongly absorbs the moods of people around them.

character_archetypes.name: Empathic Observer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: notices emotional shifts others miss.

character_archetypes.name: Low-Empathy Strategist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: understands reactions intellectually but gives little weight to others' suffering.

character_archetypes.name: Moral Injury Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: struggles after participating in or witnessing actions that violate core values.

character_archetypes.name: Identity in Crisis
character_archetypes.core_pattern: loses a role, belief, or relationship that previously organised life.

character_archetypes.name: Person in Recovery
character_archetypes.core_pattern: rebuilds routines and relationships after a destructive pattern.

Note: These are narrative patterns, not clinical diagnoses. If a story includes a mental-health condition, research it specifically and avoid equating a diagnosis with villainy or comic relief.

J. MYSTERY, CRIME, THRILLER, AND INVESTIGATION

character_archetypes.name: Relentless Investigator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: follows evidence despite pressure.

character_archetypes.name: Intuitive Investigator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: notices patterns but must test assumptions.

character_archetypes.name: Rule-Breaking Detective
character_archetypes.core_pattern: bends procedure for results and risks harming the case.

character_archetypes.name: By-the-Book Investigator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: protects evidence and due process but may be inflexible.

character_archetypes.name: Haunted Investigator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: carries unresolved personal history into a case.

character_archetypes.name: Amateur Sleuth
character_archetypes.core_pattern: investigates through curiosity, proximity, or personal stakes.

character_archetypes.name: Reluctant Witness
character_archetypes.core_pattern: knows something important but fears the consequences of speaking.

character_archetypes.name: Unreliable Witness
character_archetypes.core_pattern: gives incomplete or distorted testimony, intentionally or otherwise.

character_archetypes.name: Hidden Witness
character_archetypes.core_pattern: observes events without initially being recognised as important.

character_archetypes.name: False Suspect
character_archetypes.core_pattern: appears guilty because of misleading evidence or bias.

character_archetypes.name: Red-Herring Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: draws attention away from the actual explanation.

character_archetypes.name: Secret-Keeper
character_archetypes.core_pattern: protects a truth for love, fear, loyalty, or self-interest.

character_archetypes.name: Informant
character_archetypes.core_pattern: trades information for protection, money, status, or revenge.

character_archetypes.name: Double Agent
character_archetypes.core_pattern: serves competing sides and must manage conflicting loyalties.

character_archetypes.name: Forensic Specialist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: interprets physical or digital evidence.

character_archetypes.name: Pattern Analyst
character_archetypes.core_pattern: connects incidents that appear unrelated.

character_archetypes.name: Journalist Investigator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: pursues a story against institutional resistance.

character_archetypes.name: Amateur Hacker or Technical Investigator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: uncovers information through technical skill; avoid magical competence.

character_archetypes.name: Corrupt Investigator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: uses the investigation for personal gain.

character_archetypes.name: Procedural Obstructionist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: delays truth through bureaucracy or manipulation.

character_archetypes.name: Confession-Seeker
character_archetypes.core_pattern: believes an admission matters more than corroborating evidence.

character_archetypes.name: Innocent Person Under Suspicion
character_archetypes.core_pattern: reveals the costs of accusation and social judgement.

character_archetypes.name: Criminal with a Code
character_archetypes.core_pattern: follows personal rules that may conflict with law or morality.

character_archetypes.name: Professional Criminal
character_archetypes.core_pattern: treats crime as work governed by skill, risk, and loyalty.

character_archetypes.name: Desperate Offender
character_archetypes.core_pattern: commits wrongdoing under pressure and faces escalating consequences.

character_archetypes.name: Opportunistic Criminal
character_archetypes.core_pattern: exploits openings without a grand ideology.

character_archetypes.name: Mastermind
character_archetypes.core_pattern: coordinates a complex plan but should have credible limits and blind spots.

character_archetypes.name: Accomplice with Doubts
character_archetypes.core_pattern: begins questioning the plan or its morality.

character_archetypes.name: Enforcer with a Conscience
character_archetypes.core_pattern: carries out violence while struggling with its consequences.

character_archetypes.name: Crime Victim with Agency
character_archetypes.core_pattern: has choices, knowledge, and life beyond the crime.

character_archetypes.name: Survivor Who Refuses Silence
character_archetypes.core_pattern: acts to reclaim voice or prevent recurrence.

character_archetypes.name: Vigilante
character_archetypes.core_pattern: bypasses institutions to impose personal justice.

character_archetypes.name: Obsessive Pursuer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: confuses investigation with possession or revenge.

character_archetypes.name: Anonymous Caller
character_archetypes.core_pattern: provides clues while concealing identity and motive.

character_archetypes.name: Narrator Who Misleads
character_archetypes.core_pattern: shapes audience belief through selective information.

character_archetypes.name: Person Who Knows Too Much
character_archetypes.core_pattern: becomes vulnerable because of their knowledge.

character_archetypes.name: Investigator with Conflict of Interest
character_archetypes.core_pattern: has personal ties that compromise judgement.

character_archetypes.name: Innocent Accomplice
character_archetypes.core_pattern: helps without understanding the full plan.

character_archetypes.name: Cover-Up Architect
character_archetypes.core_pattern: coordinates concealment after a mistake or crime.

character_archetypes.name: Truth Revealer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: discloses the key fact, perhaps too late to prevent harm.

character_archetypes.name: Sceptic
character_archetypes.core_pattern: rejects supernatural explanations and seeks ordinary causes.

character_archetypes.name: Believer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: interprets events through spiritual or supernatural frameworks.

character_archetypes.name: Ambiguous Witness
character_archetypes.core_pattern: reports experiences that remain open to multiple explanations.

character_archetypes.name: Isolated Protagonist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: lacks reliable support or external verification.

character_archetypes.name: Vulnerable Newcomer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: enters a place with hidden rules and history.

character_archetypes.name: Keeper of Local Lore
character_archetypes.core_pattern: knows stories, taboos, and warnings.

character_archetypes.name: Warning Ignorer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: dismisses danger because of pride, disbelief, or urgency.

character_archetypes.name: Protective Parent in Horror
character_archetypes.core_pattern: tries to keep a child safe while facing disbelief or uncertainty.

character_archetypes.name: Possessed or Influenced Character
character_archetypes.core_pattern: experiences agency being compromised; rules must be consistent.

character_archetypes.name: Haunted Survivor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: carries a past event that intrudes on the present.

character_archetypes.name: Monster with Human Motive
character_archetypes.core_pattern: threat has recognisable needs, grief, hunger, or injustice.

character_archetypes.name: Unknowable Entity
character_archetypes.core_pattern: resists human explanation and may be frightening precisely because it cannot be understood.

character_archetypes.name: False Medium
character_archetypes.core_pattern: exploits belief for control or profit.

character_archetypes.name: Genuine Medium or Seer
character_archetypes.core_pattern: receives information with limitations and consequences.

character_archetypes.name: Rational Caregiver
character_archetypes.core_pattern: seeks medical, practical, or environmental explanations while protecting others.

character_archetypes.name: Contagion Carrier
character_archetypes.core_pattern: spreads a threat without initially understanding it.

character_archetypes.name: Group Denier
character_archetypes.core_pattern: keeps the group functioning by refusing to acknowledge danger.

character_archetypes.name: Panic Spreader
character_archetypes.core_pattern: amplifies fear through rumour and impulsive action.

character_archetypes.name: Sacrificial Protector
character_archetypes.core_pattern: accepts danger for another person, with meaningful cost.

character_archetypes.name: Survivor Who Breaks the Pattern
character_archetypes.core_pattern: discovers how to stop a recurring threat.

character_archetypes.name: Ritual Keeper
character_archetypes.core_pattern: follows rules whose purpose may be protective, coercive, or misunderstood.

character_archetypes.name: Transgressor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: breaks a taboo and triggers consequences.

character_archetypes.name: Cursed Heir
character_archetypes.core_pattern: inherits a threat along with family history.

character_archetypes.name: Skeptical Investigator of the Paranormal
character_archetypes.core_pattern: gathers evidence while remaining open to uncertainty.

character_archetypes.name: Human Monster
character_archetypes.core_pattern: ordinary person whose cruelty is more disturbing than supernatural spectacle.

character_archetypes.name: Tactical Planner
character_archetypes.core_pattern: wins through preparation and contingency thinking.

character_archetypes.name: Instinctive Fighter
character_archetypes.core_pattern: reacts quickly but may lack long-term strategy.

character_archetypes.name: Reluctant Warrior
character_archetypes.core_pattern: avoids violence until circumstances force a decision.

character_archetypes.name: Honour-Bound Fighter
character_archetypes.core_pattern: follows a code that may become a weakness.

character_archetypes.name: Pragmatic Survivor
character_archetypes.core_pattern: chooses what works over what looks noble.

character_archetypes.name: Protector
character_archetypes.core_pattern: prioritises another person's safety.

character_archetypes.name: Lone Wolf
character_archetypes.core_pattern: avoids dependence and must confront the limits of isolation.

character_archetypes.name: Team Specialist
character_archetypes.core_pattern: contributes a specific skill and depends on coordination.

character_archetypes.name: Reckless Daredevil
character_archetypes.core_pattern: confuses risk-taking with courage.

character_archetypes.name: Disciplined Professional
character_archetypes.core_pattern: relies on training, procedure, and composure.

character_archetypes.name: Veteran Haunted by Conflict
character_archetypes.core_pattern: carries memories and moral costs from earlier violence.

character_archetypes.name: New Recruit
character_archetypes.core_pattern: learns under pressure and confronts idealised beliefs.

character_archetypes.name: Disillusioned Soldier
character_archetypes.core_pattern: questions the mission or institution.

character_archetypes.name: Loyal Commander
character_archetypes.core_pattern: balances mission and the lives of subordinates.

character_archetypes.name: Ruthless Commander
character_archetypes.core_pattern: treats people as expendable resources.

character_archetypes.name: Medic or Caregiver Under Fire
character_archetypes.core_pattern: protects life amid chaos.

character_archetypes.name: Civilian Caught in Conflict
character_archetypes.core_pattern: reveals war's effects beyond combatants.

character_archetypes.name: Negotiator
character_archetypes.core_pattern: uses communication to prevent or limit violence.

character_archetypes.name: Hostage with Agency
character_archetypes.core_pattern: acts strategically despite constrained choices.

character_archetypes.name: Captive Who Adapts
character_archetypes.core_pattern: learns to survive through observation and resourcefulness.

character_archetypes.name: Reluctant Sacrifice
character_archetypes.core_pattern: faces a cost that cannot be avoided without harming others.
